title: Equivalences of promise compactness principles
summary: For a pair of finite relational structures $(\mathfrak{A},\mathfrak{B})$ such that $\mathfrak{A}$ homomorphically maps to $\mathfrak{B}$ we denote by $K_{(\mathfrak{A},\mathfrak{B})}$ the following statement: for all structures $\mathfrak{I}$ with the same signature as $\mathfrak{A}$ if all finite substructures of $\mathfrak{I}$ homomorphically maps to $\mathfrak{A}$ then $\mathfrak{I}$ homomorphically maps to $\mathfrak{B}$.
